The '''Coruscant Building Authority''' was an agency operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. It ensured that buildings in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] were built with the proper permits and that blueprints of all buildings were filed with the agency.
